== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Durandiel, also known as the [[Ghost]], is a member of the [[Court]] of Seven. Formerly identified as Eiras Luriana of Obelisk, she distinguishes herself from her peers by eschewing armor in favor of a dull gray dress that transitions into smoke. She wields an instrument known as the Staff of the [[Ghost]], which she uses to manipulate reality and interact with the fundamental strings of time. Her abilities include manifesting ripples in space, appearing and disappearing from visibility, and navigating warped dimensions. She possesses significant power, capable of halting massive celestial [[chains]] and reversing injuries or planetary destruction. While she can appear distant or cold, she has been described as friendly by some and has shown interest in recruiting talented individuals to her organization.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Known as the [[Ghost]], Durandiel wears a dress made of gray smoke spun into fabric. This garment appears as a dull gray dress.}}
